overview: A low price that loses money is not a deal. We work out your costs and fees, set a price floor for each product and choose which offers fit: coupons, lightning or limited-time deals, promotions and bundles. We set them up in your own account within the marketplace's pricing rules, with start and end dates and a note of the expected margin, so you know what each offer costs.

faq: Do you set prices for me?
We recommend prices and set them in your account after you approve them. You know your suppliers and customers best, so we show the numbers and let you make the call on every price.
Can you help me win the featured offer spot?

Win rules are decided by the marketplace and can change. We make sure your price, stock and account health meet the known conditions, but we cannot promise the spot and never manipulate prices to cheat the system.
Are fake discounts or inflated list prices part of this?
No. Marketplaces and consumer laws ban misleading reference prices. We only show real previous prices and offers you can honor, and we follow each marketplace's pricing policy.
Do you need my product costs?
For the margin work, yes: buying cost, shipping and packaging. A simple sheet is enough. Without them, we can only check marketplace fees and rules, not whether an offer makes money.
